title: Game screens
description:
Move between title, play, pause and game over screens with a state machine.

```
TITLE  --Enter--> PLAY
PLAY   --P-->     PAUSE --P--> PLAY
PLAY   --lives 0--> GAME_OVER --Enter--> TITLE
in PAUSE, the game does not update
```
hints: A `switch (s)` with one inner `if` per allowed event keeps the rules readable (lesson 2.05).
Reset the game's state when going from game over to the title, not when starting play, so the title can show the last score.
requirements: `enum class Screen` and a function `next(screen, event)`.
Only allowed transitions happen; other events are ignored.
Each screen has its own update and draw functions; pause keeps drawing the game underneath.
stretch: Add a fade between screens that blocks input while it plays.
